mapper.select: SELECT #{end} time,entrance_id area,service type,sum(sum) count FROM ntc_entrance_report WHERE report_time between #{start} AND #{end} AND entrance_id in (#{area1EntranceId},#{area2EntranceId}) GROUP BY service , entrance_id ORDER BY count desc LIMIT 10;
